cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Mum's asking who broke her vase. Will you tell her, or keep your promise to your little brother?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Clear the cleaner. Do you have to name me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are you answering her, or keeping the promise I trusted you with?

mechanism: A manages answer scope as if supervising a statement, pressing B to choose between a direct truthful answer and sibling loyalty.
confusable: Mere secrecy seeks concealment; D130 puts a relationship promise directly against the demanded truthful answer.
comparison: Sibling promise and an innocent cleaner differ from professional partners facing a client question.
seedUse: Use Mum's vase, cleaner and direct question; professional correction controls order and scope of answers.
